answer: Under the blind-baseline increment gate, each juror first writes and seals a reference answer to the same three words before any submission is revealed. Pay goes only to verified insight an answer adds beyond those independent baselines; plain restatement earns nothing. A farm rotating zenith, ivory and horizon through one template sits at or below the blind references, so its marginal contribution collapses to zero on every copy. To pass, each account must supply reasoning that outruns an unseen panel, costing N genuine creations rather than one draft recycled N times.
